criteria.deficiency: No blocking gap. Divergences, all edge cases: (a) Escape awaits set_focus (patch.diff:552); the reference does not (reference.diff:747), so the reference's Escape is a no-op. The candidate matches the documented intent. (b) An empty label gets 0 cells (patch.diff:279-280), while the reference gives it a flexible share with min 1 (reference.diff:598 with base _layout_resolve.py:38). When no space remains, layout_resolve still returns 1 (base _layout_resolve.py:55), so the candidate is inconsistent there. (c) Bar position uses the displayed index (patch.diff:472); the reference uses the full-list index (reference.diff:816), which can exceed the displayed range (reference.diff:651-654). The candidate's behavior is the correct one. (d) First-character search applies only to single-character keys (patch.diff:559); the reference accepts any key (reference.diff:754-755).
